proposals.title: CanonicalEncoder: minimal-scope fresh attempt with golden-byte tests
proposals.why_now: Six consecutive encoder attempts (TASK-0004 through TASK-0007, three iterations each on 0007 alone) have all been rejected, leaving the workspace with zero production code after 10+ hours of benchmark time. The encoder gates INV-01, INV-22, and CI gate step 5 — without it no StateHash can exist. The systematic failure pattern suggests the previous attempts kept expanding scope to answer each new reviewer finding, resulting in ever-larger attack surfaces and new findings. A narrower attempt that admits exactly the types ADR-009 requires for CICLO state (null, boolean, bigint, safe-integer number, string, plain-object with string-only own data-property keys, Array of admitted values, Uint8Array) and rejects everything else explicitly — confirmed by golden-byte fixture tests with hard-coded expected hex — is more likely to survive review than a general-purpose encoder with adversarial coverage bolted on after rejection.

proposals.title: Core branded arithmetic types: Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires 'core completo. Aritmética inteira' as its first scope item. These types are independent of the encoder and independent of any hash or RNG — they can be implemented and accepted while encoder attempts continue. They are prerequisites for the ledger, the price generator, the tick loop, and every downstream package. ADR-003 specifies their representation precisely (bigint branded for Money/Quantity/Price/Rate; safe-integer number branded for Tick). No task currently blocks this work.

proposals.title: Write hash function ADR (DEFINIR from ADR-002)
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 is TRAVADA and mandates the hash function be 'especificada bit a bit em ADR, e não pode ser a função de hash nativa'. This is listed as an explicit DEFINIR item in §19. Without the ADR, the positional rand() function cannot be implemented correctly, blocking the RNG and in turn the price generator. Writing the ADR is a documentation-only task with no code changes, low rejection risk, and high unblocking value. It can proceed in parallel with the encoder attempt.

proposals.title: Implement positional RNG: rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates)
proposals.why_now: INV-02 — 'consultar price(asset, t) diretamente é igual a chegar em t avançando tick por tick' — is described in the spec as the most important test in the project. It depends entirely on the positional RNG. Every market namespace (market.trend, market.factor, market.regime, macro.schedule, bot.policy, etc.) derives from rand(). FASE-1 requires the price generator with two noise layers, which requires rand(). This task unblocks the price generator and the full tick loop.

proposals.title: Minimum Electron installer for Windows and Linux
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance criteria explicitly require 'Instalador mínimo para Windows e Linux produzido pelo CI, ainda que a aplicação faça pouco'. The spec at §14.6 warns: 'se o empacotamento multiplataforma aparecer depois, o time descobre problema de módulo nativo, de ABI e de caminho de arquivo na última semana'. After 10+ hours with zero accepted tasks, this risk is now pressing. A minimal installer (an Electron window showing a placeholder) is independent of the encoder, arithmetic types, and RNG — it can be delivered immediately and would be the first accepted deliverable to break the stall.

warnings: Systematic encoder rejection: six consecutive attempts (TASK-0004 through TASK-0007 attempt-03) have failed. The pattern suggests each attempt added complexity to address the latest review finding while creating new surface area for the next. A seventh attempt must be narrower, not broader: admit only the exact types that appear in CICLO state (null, boolean, bigint, safe-integer number, string, plain object with string-keyed own data properties, Array, Uint8Array), reject everything else with an explicit error code, and prove correctness with golden-byte fixtures rather than adversarial property tests.

Zero accepted tasks in 10.5 hours represents total project stall. Parallel independent tasks (IDEA-002 through IDEA-005) must be assigned concurrently with the encoder retry rather than sequentially after it — waiting for the encoder to be accepted before starting arithmetic types or the installer reproduces the same single-threaded bottleneck that caused the stall.

The spec at §14.6 states the installer must exist in FASE-1 and warns explicitly about last-week ABI failures if deferred. After 10+ hours of stall, this risk is no longer theoretical. IDEA-005 (minimum installer) can be accepted independently of all other FASE-1 work and would be the first tangible deliverable of the benchmark.
